title: CNIC employee work stoppage over salary arrears at the Douala shipyard
reason: The opened article describes a workplace stoppage and negotiations with company management, not a public gathering/march or a demand on state policy; no participant total is reported. The manual does not code company-specific labor negotiations until the action becomes a public event or demands state action.
notes: This is the predecessor labor stoppage to the distinct June 7 report of an employee gathering outside company premises. Do not infer a May public assembly or threshold from the stoppage. The public enterprise status alone does not establish a policy target.
